user.title: Add a child's Vklass schedule
user.description:
In Vklass, open the schedule page, choose "Prenumerera på schema" and copy the link for the child. Paste it below. Repeat "Add integration" for each child.

The lunch link is optional: the school's page on skolmaten.se, for example `https://skolmaten.se/yourschool`.

data_description.url: The link looks like https://cal.vklass.se/….ics (webcal:// links work too). Anyone with the link can see the schedule, so keep it private.
